name: Lucky Paradox
storyline:
Have you suddenly felt that all your decisions are being made by someone else? You wake up in a bed and the first thing you find is a letter from your best friend promising to meet in his hometown, but you'll never imagine the adventure and people that await you in Argleton.

Argleton is a town that has a mystery that no one has been able to discover, you will have to meet people and know more about their past, keep a restaurant running, restore a museum that was mysteriously destroyed, just to find out what hides this mysterious town.

And make a harem with a bunch of beautiful girls along the way too!
summary: Lucky Paradox is a harem focused adult visual novel with a mysterious and puzzling Story. You will also find loads of cuteness, love, and passion.
